en: Tondo, also called the Kingdom of Tondo, as a Tagalog and Kapampangan settlement and major trade hub on the northern part of the Pasig River delta on Luzon
Its standing together with Maynila as one of the polities of the delta
zh: 汤都又称汤都王国，是吕宋岛帕西格河三角洲北部的他加禄与邦板牙聚落与重要贸易中心
与马尼拉同为三角洲上的政体

politics.zh: 汤都又称汤都王国，是吕宋岛帕西格河三角洲北部的他加禄与邦板牙人聚落与重要贸易中心，与马尼拉同为三角洲上的政体。它由本地首领（拉坎）统治，与中国、日本及东南亚各地商人往来；1571年西班牙人到来后被并入马尼拉，其地位由殖民体系取代。
politics.en: Tondo, also known as the Kingdom of Tondo, was a Tagalog and Kapampangan settlement and major trade hub on the northern part of the Pasig River delta on Luzon. Together with Maynila it was one of the polities of the delta, ruled by local chiefs called lakan and trading with merchants from China, Japan and Southeast Asia, until the arrival of the Spanish in 1571, when it was joined to Manila and its standing was replaced by the colonial order.

economy.zh: 经济以帕西格河的水运、渔业与稻作农业为基础，河口港口是中国瓷器、丝绸与东南亚香料、林产品的交换地，贸易税收支撑首领的权力。
economy.en: The economy rested on river transport, fishing and rice farming along the Pasig, the delta ports exchanging Chinese porcelain and silk for Southeast Asian spices and forest products, and trade revenue underpinning the chiefs' power.

culture.zh: 社会以巴朗盖为单位，使用本地文字，伊斯兰教随贸易传入并与本地信仰并存，汤都的口传谱系与后来的殖民记录保存了其历史。
culture.en: Society was organised in barangays and used a native script; Islam arrived with trade and existed alongside local beliefs, and Tondo's oral genealogies together with later colonial records preserve its history. Its trade goods and scripts show those connections clearly.

events.zh: 关键节点包括14至15世纪成为贸易中心、与马尼拉及婆罗洲政权的往来、1570至1571年西班牙人的进攻，以及此后并入殖民体系。
events.en: Key moments are its rise as a trade centre in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, its dealings with Maynila and Bornean polities, the Spanish attacks of 1570-1571 and its incorporation into the colonial order afterwards.

value.zh: 是帕西格河三角洲的重要贸易中心。
value.en: It was a major trade hub of the Pasig River delta.
After 1571 it was absorbed into the Spanish colonial order.

en: Negeri Sembilan as a state in Malaysia on the western coast of Peninsular Malaysia
Its borders with Selangor to the north and Pahang to the east
Its historical spelling Negri Sembilan and its Minangkabau customary law
zh: 森美兰是马来西亚半岛西岸的州
旧拼作Negri Sembilan，实行米南加保习惯法

politics.zh: 森美兰是马来西亚半岛西岸的州，北邻雪兰莪，东接彭亨，旧拼作Negri Sembilan，名称意为「九个州」，反映其由多个米南加保移民聚落联合而成。它以米南加保习惯法（adat perpatih）组织社会与土地制度，由选出的最高统治者与四大酋长共同治理，19世纪起受英国保护，1948年加入马来亚联合邦。
politics.en: Negeri Sembilan is a state in Malaysia on the western coast of Peninsular Malaysia, bordered by Selangor to the north and Pahang to the east; its historical spelling is Negri Sembilan and its name means nine states, reflecting its formation from several Minangkabau settlements. Its society and land tenure rest on Minangkabau customary law, adat perpatih, and it is governed by an elected paramount ruler together with four territorial chiefs; it came under British protection in the nineteenth century and joined the Federation of Malaya in 1948.

economy.zh: 经济以农业、橡胶与油棕种植为基础，沿海港口与铁路连接吉隆坡与马六甲，近年来制造业与服务业在州内发展。
economy.en: The economy rests on agriculture and on rubber and oil palm plantations, its coastal ports and railway linking Kuala Lumpur with Malacca, and manufacturing and services have grown in the state in recent years. Its position on the coast has long favoured trade.

culture.zh: 森美兰保留米南加保母系继承与习惯法传统，马来语与米南加保方言并用，传统民居与舞蹈音乐体现西苏门答腊文化的影响。
culture.en: Negeri Sembilan keeps Minangkabau matrilineal inheritance and customary law, Malay and the Minangkabau dialect are both spoken, and its traditional houses, dance and music show the influence of West Sumatran culture. Its customary law still governs land and inheritance.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15至18世纪米南加保移民的定居、1773年前后形成联合政体、19世纪英国保护，以及1948年加入马来亚联合邦。
events.en: Key moments are the settlement of Minangkabau migrants between the fifteenth and eighteenth centuries, the formation of a confederate polity around 1773, British protection in the nineteenth century and entry into the Federation of Malaya in 1948.

value.zh: 名称意为「九个州」，由米南加保聚落联合而成。
value.en: Its name means nine states and reflects its union of Minangkabau settlements.

value.zh: 实行米南加保习惯法 adat perpatih。
value.en: It follows the Minangkabau customary law adat perpatih.

en: Patani, or the Sultanate of Patani, as a Malay sultanate in the historical Patani region
Its area covering approximately the modern Thai provinces of Patani, Yala and Narathiwat and part of the Malaysian state of Kelantan
Its succession to the earlier state of Langkasuka
zh: 北大年又称北大年苏丹国，是北大年地区的马来苏丹国
地域约相当于今泰国北大年、也拉、那拉提瓦三府与马来西亚吉兰丹州部分地区

politics.zh: 北大年又称北大年苏丹国，是马来半岛东岸北大年地区的马来苏丹国，地域约相当于今泰国北大年、也拉、那拉提瓦三府与马来西亚吉兰丹州部分地区，接续更早的狼牙修国。它由苏丹统治，以港口贸易与稻米、香料出口繁荣，17世纪达到鼎盛，18世纪后期被暹罗征服，其地后成为泰国南部诸府。
politics.en: Patani, or the Sultanate of Patani, was a Malay sultanate in the historical Patani region, covering approximately the area of the modern Thai provinces of Patani, Yala and Narathiwat together with part of the Malaysian state of Kelantan, and succeeding the earlier state of Langkasuka. Ruled by sultans, it prospered on port trade and the export of rice and spices, reached its height in the seventeenth century and was conquered by Siam in the later eighteenth, its territory later becoming the southern provinces of Thailand.

economy.zh: 经济以港口贸易、稻米与渔业为基础，北大年港连接中国、日本、马来半岛与东南亚各地，是区域重要的商品集散地。
economy.en: The economy rested on port trade, rice and fisheries, the harbour of Patani linking China, Japan, the Malay peninsula and Southeast Asia, and it was an important regional entrepot for goods. Its markets drew merchants from several continents.

culture.zh: 北大年社会以马来穆斯林文化为基础，爪夷文与马来语用于行政与宗教，伊斯兰教与本地传统结合，清真寺与宫廷文学留下遗产。
culture.en: Patani society rested on Malay Muslim culture, Jawi and Malay were used in administration and religion, Islam combined with local traditions, and its mosques and court literature remain as heritage. Its manuscripts and mosques record that heritage.

events.zh: 关键节点包括14至15世纪苏丹国的形成、17世纪的贸易鼎盛、18世纪后期的内部纷争，以及1786年后被暹罗征服。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the sultanate in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, the height of its trade in the seventeenth, internal conflict in the later eighteenth and the conquest by Siam after 1786.

value.en: It succeeded the earlier state of Langkasuka.
Siam conquered it in the later eighteenth century.

en: Papua New Guinea as an island nation in Oceania comprising the eastern half of the island of New Guinea and offshore islands in Melanesia
Its land border with Indonesia to the west and its position north of Australia
zh: 巴布亚新几内亚是大洋洲岛国，包括新几内亚岛东半部与美拉尼西亚的离岸岛屿
西与印度尼西亚有陆地边界，位于澳大利亚以北

politics.zh: 巴布亚新几内亚独立国是大洋洲的岛国，包括新几内亚岛东半部与美拉尼西亚的离岸岛屿，西与印度尼西亚接壤，位于澳大利亚以北，首都为莫尔兹比港。国家为英联邦内的议会制君主立宪国，1975年脱离澳大利亚管理独立，全国由众多语言与部落社群构成，地方自治与资源开发是长期政治议题。
politics.en: The Independent State of Papua New Guinea is an island nation in Oceania comprising the eastern half of the island of New Guinea and offshore islands in Melanesia, with a land border with Indonesia to the west and lying north of Australia, its capital being Port Moresby. A parliamentary monarchy within the Commonwealth, it became independent from Australian administration in 1975, and with hundreds of language and tribal communities, provincial autonomy and resource development are lasting political questions.

economy.zh: 经济以矿产与天然气出口为基础，铜、金与液化天然气是主要产品，农业以自给性种植为主，咖啡、可可与棕榈油是重要现金作物。
economy.en: The economy is based on mineral and gas exports, with copper, gold and liquefied natural gas as the main products, while farming is largely subsistence and coffee, cocoa and palm oil are important cash crops.

culture.zh: 巴布亚新几内亚是世界上语言最多的国家之一，八百多种语言并存，社群以部落与氏族为单位，传统交换体系与仪式在部分地区延续至今。
culture.en: Papua New Guinea is one of the most linguistically diverse countries in the world, with more than eight hundred languages, communities organised by tribe and clan, and traditional exchange systems and ceremonies surviving in some regions.

events.zh: 关键节点包括19世纪德国与英国的分治、1906年起澳大利亚管理、第二次世界大战中的太平洋战场，以及1975年独立。
events.en: Key moments are the German and British partitions of the nineteenth century, Australian administration from 1906, the Pacific campaigns of the Second World War and independence in 1975. Its provinces have since gained greater powers of their own.

value.en: It became independent from Australian administration in 1975.

value.zh: 拥有八百多种语言，是世界上语言最多的国家之一。
value.en: With over eight hundred languages it is among the most diverse countries in the world.

en: The Sultanate of Gowa as one of the great kingdoms in Indonesian history and the most successful kingdom in the South Sulawesi region
Its people the Makassarese, who lived at the southern end and west coast of southern Sulawesi
zh: 戈瓦苏丹国是印度尼西亚历史上的重要王国，也是南苏拉威西地区最成功的王国
居民为居住在苏拉威西南部南端与西海岸的望加锡人

politics.zh: 戈瓦苏丹国是印度尼西亚历史上的重要王国，也是南苏拉威西地区最成功的王国，居民为居住在苏拉威西南部南端与西海岸的望加锡人。王国在16世纪接受伊斯兰教后迅速扩张，与塔洛克等邻邦组成联盟，控制香料贸易与东印度群岛的海上商路；17世纪在与荷兰东印度公司的战争中失败，1667年《邦加亚条约》后势力大减。
politics.en: The Sultanate of Gowa was one of the great kingdoms in Indonesian history and the most successful kingdom in the South Sulawesi region, its people the Makassarese who lived at the southern end and on the west coast of southern Sulawesi. After adopting Islam in the sixteenth century it expanded rapidly, forming a union with neighbouring Tallo and controlling the spice trade and the sea routes of the eastern archipelago; it was defeated in war with the Dutch East India Company and its power was much reduced by the Treaty of Bongaya in 1667.

economy.zh: 经济以海上贸易与港口为支柱，望加锡成为东印度群岛的香料、布匹与海产集散地，稻米与渔业支撑城市人口，贸易税是国家收入的主要来源。
economy.en: The economy rested on maritime trade and its port, Makassar becoming an entrepot for spices, cloth and marine products in the eastern archipelago, with rice and fisheries supporting the urban population and trade taxes the main source of state revenue.

culture.zh: 望加锡文化以航海传统、伊斯兰教与本地习惯法为基础，望加锡语与布吉语文献记录了王统与航海知识，造船与航海技术闻名区域。
culture.en: Makassarese culture rests on seafaring tradition, Islam and local customary law, its Makassarese and Bugis manuscripts recording royal lines and navigational knowledge, and its shipbuilding and navigation were famous in the region. Its sailors carried its trade across the archipelago.

events.zh: 关键节点包括16世纪初王国兴起、1605年前后接受伊斯兰教、17世纪前期与荷兰东印度公司的冲突，以及1667年《邦加亚条约》后的衰落。
events.en: Key moments are the rise of the kingdom in the early sixteenth century, the adoption of Islam around 1605, the conflicts with the Dutch East India Company in the early seventeenth and the decline that followed the Treaty of Bongaya in 1667.

value.en: The Treaty of Bongaya of 1667 much reduced its power.

en: The Demak Sultanate as a Javanese Muslim state on Java's north coast, at the site of the present-day city of Demak
Its origin as a port fief to the Hindu-Buddhist Majapahit kingdom, founded in the last quarter of the fifteenth century
zh: 淡目苏丹国是爪哇北岸的穆斯林国家，位于今淡目市一带
原为印度教-佛教满者伯夷王国的港口封地，15世纪最后四分之一建立

politics.zh: 淡目苏丹国是爪哇北岸的穆斯林国家，位于今印度尼西亚淡目市一带，原为印度教-佛教满者伯夷王国的港口封地，在15世纪最后四分之一建立，受穆斯林商人传入的伊斯兰教影响。它是爪哇第一个伊斯兰苏丹国，16世纪初一度控制爪哇中部与东部，1546年后因内部纷争与地方势力崛起而衰落，其王统由巴章与马打蓝承续。
politics.en: The Demak Sultanate was a Javanese Muslim state on Java's north coast at the site of the present-day city of Demak. A port fief to the Hindu-Buddhist Majapahit kingdom, it was founded in the last quarter of the fifteenth century and was influenced by Islam brought by Muslim traders. The first Islamic sultanate in Java, it controlled parts of central and eastern Java in the early sixteenth century before internal conflict and rising local powers weakened it after 1546, its royal line continuing through Pajang and Mataram.

economy.zh: 经济以爪哇北岸的港口贸易与稻作农业为基础，淡目港参与香料、稻米与布匹贸易，河网与海路连接爪哇内陆与东南亚市场。
economy.en: The economy rested on port trade along Java's north coast and on rice farming, the harbour of Demak taking part in the trade in spices, rice and cloth, with rivers and sea routes linking the Javanese interior to Southeast Asian markets.

culture.zh: 淡目是爪哇伊斯兰化的重要中心，爪哇九圣中的多位在此活动，清真寺建筑与爪哇宫廷传统结合，爪哇语与阿拉伯语用于宗教与行政。
culture.en: Demak was an important centre of Islamisation in Java, several of the nine saints being active there, its mosque architecture combining with Javanese court tradition, and Javanese and Arabic used in religion and administration. Its court also patronised the earliest Javanese Islamic texts.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15世纪末建国、1527年前后攻灭满者伯夷残余势力、16世纪初的扩张，以及1546年苏丹特连加纳去世后的衰落。
events.en: Key moments are the founding at the end of the fifteenth century, the defeat of the remnants of Majapahit around 1527, the expansion of the early sixteenth century and the decline after the death of Sultan Trenggana in 1546.

value.zh: 是爪哇第一个伊斯兰苏丹国。
value.en: It was the first Islamic sultanate in Java.

value.zh: 原为满者伯夷的港口封地。
value.en: It began as a port fief of Majapahit.
